S.B. D.1702

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
& S. L. R.C.C.
No. S. B. D. 1702.
Date 7 - 11 - 30.

November 7, 30.

Sir,

With reference to your letter,
No. 3372, dated October 31, 1930, I have to
inform you that there is nothing in Police
records against Mr. K.D. Miller, who has
applied to your Consulate for a visa to the
Netherlands Indies.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

T-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 337

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
& S. REC
S. B. D. 1702
Re 1 - 11 - 30.

SHANGHAI, 31st October 1930.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that E. D. Miller,
Manager of the Far East Division of Eli Lilly & Co.,
a firm dealing in pharmaceutical and biological products,
intends to go to Netherlands India on a business trip.
Mr. Miller holds a passport issued by the local
American Consul-General on 3 April 1929, No.1117, and
gave as his private address 241 Connaught Road. The firm
is established at 316 Kiangse Road (formerly No.42).
I would be much obliged to know whether anything
is known in Police Records against this person.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Chinese-Secretary.

R. C. Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner,
Crime & Special Branches,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。
编号：337

上海公共租界工部局
& S. REC
S. B. D. 1702
收文日期：30年11月1日。

上海，1930年10月31日。

先生：

谨此奉告，礼来公司（Eli Lilly & Co.，一家经营药品及生物制品的公司）远东分部经理E. D. Miller拟前往荷属印度进行商务旅行。Miller先生持有美国驻本地总领事于1929年4月3日签发的第1117号护照，其私人住址为康纳路241号。该公司设于江西路316号（原42号）。如蒙告知警务处档案中是否有对此人不利的记录，不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，
[签名]
中文秘书。

R. C. Aiers 先生，
副总监，
刑事及特别处，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（左侧手写批注）：
* 先生，
特别处登记簿无记录。
[签名]
... 同上 ... 11月1日
Arnie 登记簿
588 11月2日。

巡捕（特别处）
请提供资料
已收
11月2日
